## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; demo data updated if a resource, column, filter or drill changed
- [ ] The PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat(ec2): ...`, `fix(ui): ...`); it becomes the changelog line
- [ ] Breaking change? Mark it with `!` (`feat!:`) and describe it above
